title: Check in with Mertie

nodes.speaker: Mertie Batt
nodes.text: Alright, sweetcheeks? You getting enough rest?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Alright, sweetcheeks? You getting enough rest?

nodes.speaker: Mertie Batt
nodes.text: Pah! You're sounding more and more like a corpster. You wanna watch it. This place'll suck the life right outta you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Pah! You're sounding more and more like a corpster. You wanna watch it. This place'll suck the life right outta you.

nodes.speaker: Mertie Batt
nodes.text: Ha, that's what I like to hear! Get out there and smell the chem trails! Life's short, take it from me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ha, that's what I like to hear! Get out there and smell the chem trails! Life's short, take it from me.

nodes.speaker: Mertie Batt
nodes.text: How many times I gotta tell you to call me auntie? I'm alright, amigo. Just thinking about all the years I spent standing in this spot, and all the things I never got to do.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How many times I gotta tell you to call me auntie? I'm alright, amigo. Just thinking about all the years I spent standing in this spot, and all the things I never got to do.

nodes.speaker: Mertie Batt
nodes.text: Like, I woulda loved to see Luna one day. Go on one of those crater cruises. Take an ascender to the Spire. But most of all... nah, it's silly.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Like, I woulda loved to see Luna one day. Go on one of those crater cruises. Take an ascender to the Spire. But most of all... nah, it's silly.

nodes.speaker: Mertie Batt
nodes.text: What, you in training for 'Sec Academy? I'm trying to tell you, kid, there's more to life than work.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What, you in training for 'Sec Academy? I'm trying to tell you, kid, there's more to life than work.

nodes.speaker: Mertie Batt
nodes.text: I always wanted to see the ocean.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I always wanted to see the ocean.

nodes.speaker: Mertie Batt
nodes.text: Oh, on the holos, sure. But that ain't the same as really seeing, is it? I'd love to paddle these old feet in the water. Know what it smells like. Feel the breeze on my face.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, on the holos, sure. But that ain't the same as really seeing, is it? I'd love to paddle these old feet in the water. Know what it smells like. Feel the breeze on my face.

nodes.speaker: Mertie Batt
nodes.text: Maybe I will, amigo. Maybe I will.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe I will, amigo. Maybe I will.

nodes.speaker: Mertie Batt
nodes.text: Well, I'd better stop talking to you and get back to work then, eh, corpster?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, I'd better stop talking to you and get back to work then, eh, corpster?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Having too much fun.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Having too much fun.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I can rest when I'm dead.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can rest when I'm dead.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I can rest when I'm dead.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I can rest when I'm dead.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Are you ok, Mertie?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you ok, Mertie?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Like what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Like what?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You've worked hard. That's the important thing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You've worked hard. That's the important thing.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You've worked hard. That's the important thing.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You've worked hard. That's the important thing.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That sounds like counter-productivity to me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That sounds like counter-productivity to me.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That sounds like counter-productivity to me.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That sounds like counter-productivity to me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You've never seen it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You've never seen it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why wait? You should go.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why wait? You should go.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It's nothing special. You're better off here, making money.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's nothing special. You're better off here, making money.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It's nothing special. You're better off here, making money.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It's nothing special. You're better off here, making money.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I promise I won't laugh.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I promise I won't laugh.
